results.title: Seva Bhavi
results.overview: The film revolves around the character Jiga, dubbed "Seva Bhavi" (meaning a selfless helper or server), who is always ready to serve the community. The story focuses on his humorous interactions and, as suggested by character teasers, his "social service" activities that create a "full-on entertainment" experience. The plot involves engaging character work and comedic situations, including characters like "Dalsukh," designed to make it a family-oriented watch.

results.title: After Me, the Deluge
results.overview: Are young people turning their backs on Quebec television, or does television simply no longer speak to them? Mounir Kaddouri  (a.k.a. Maire de Laval) kicks off the NFB's ON FILME initiative by tackling a hot topic: the growing gap between the Quebec television industry and young audiences.

results.title: Born to Lose
results.overview: A young biker grapples with his father's troubled legacy and escalating debts to a local gangster. As he races to restore a vintage motorcycle to save himself, he must confront family secrets and forge his own identity.

results.title: Vilnius: Examination 1
results.overview: An experimental visual adaptation of selected poetry written by Salomėja Nėris, Eduardas Mieželaitis, Algimantas Baltakis, Janina Degtutytė, and Justinas Marcinkevičius. Accompanied by the art of Stasys Krasauskas and narrated by Rūta Staliliūnaitė, A Song of Life and Love attempts to capture the city of Vilnius and its surroundings while documenting regular people and places in an attempt to memorialise the ordinary.

results.title: Freya
results.overview: A week before his wedding, Nick Foster's dreams are haunted by a woman in white.

results.title: Tropical Fractals
results.overview: On an interstellar journey, a group of scientists studies the last living vestiges of Earth. The artificial intelligence, Museo, becomes a portal to the crew’s diaries and a fragmented archive of humanity. On Earth, the one believed to be the last of the humans traverses a ruined planet that is slowly recovering, little by little, from the apocalypse it endured.

results.title: Family Through the Fire
results.overview: When a family's home is caught in a deadly wildfire, a husband's choice to stay behind to recover their youngest daughter turns into a fight for redemption, while his wife shepherds their other children to safety.

results.title: Outwilded
results.overview: Animal documentary meets reality TV as a group of animals must navigate rivalry, alliances, and cooperation in a race to find a key.

results.title: Scout’s Honor
results.overview: Desperate to attend the concert of their dreams before heading off to college, two friends join the legions of a fake girl scout troop in hopes of earning the money in time.

results.title: Falcons
results.overview: Andy is trained by his ex-hitman father to infiltrate Hell's Cartel, but when his sister is kidnapped and betrayal hits, the plan unravels, sparking the H-Game, turning child violence into global control.

results.title: Peekers
results.overview: While trying to get into the Christmas spirit Johnny has a horrifying encounter.

results.title: Stuart Laws: Three-Way
results.overview: Every comedian knows that the same joke, delivered the same way, doesn’t guarantee the same response. With his latest special Three-Way, Stuart Laws is letting the audience in on the joke(s) (...as they perform differently between rooms). The special cuts between 3 different locations: Machynlleth, Manchester and Bristol. Viewers buzz between the ‘best bits’ (and a couple of ‘worst bits’) from each show, making one, half-hour, pretty damn funny special.

results.title: Andrea Bocelli Romanza - Eine musikalische Nacht in der Toskana
results.original_title: Andrea Bocelli Romanza - Eine musikalische Nacht in der Toskana

results.title: New Life, Hard Choice
results.overview: James, a remorseful father, fights to rebuild a relationship with the daughter he abandoned nearly a decade ago, racing against time to make amends before the opportunity to repair their fractured bond disappears forever.

results.title: Simply Red: Holding Back The Years: 40 Years Of Simply Red, Live In Santiago
results.original_title: Simply Red: Holding Back The Years: 40 Years Of Simply Red, Live In Santiago
results.overview: Live album and concert film by British pop and soul band Simply Red. Released on June 26, 2026, it captures the band's five sold-out performances at the Movistar Arena in Santiago, Chile, where they played to over 75,000 fans.

results.title: CMA Presents I Will Always Love You: A Celebration of Dolly Parton
results.original_title: CMA Presents I Will Always Love You: A Celebration of Dolly Parton
results.overview: A celebration of the artist, songwriter, entertainer, humanitarian and entrepreneur whose music and generosity carried her from the mountains of east Tennessee into the hearts of generations around the world.
